operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a single booking by id. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token.

The trailing path segment (`1`) is the **data level** — how deeply related records are loaded — not a page or format flag.

The successful response is a **flat object** of the booking's fields (it is not wrapped in a `data` envelope) and may include related records and a `custom_data` object.

Note: requesting an id that does not exist currently returns HTTP 500 with the plain-text body `error happened` rather than a 404.

parameters.name: bookingId
parameters.description: The id of the booking to fetch.

200.description: The booking record (flat object, plus any related records and custom_data).

schema.description: A single booking record, returned flat (not wrapped). Fields depend on the account's booking configuration.

payment_status.description: Booking status code (0 Pending, 1 Confirmed, 2 Invoiced, 3 Cancelled, 4 Done).

custom_data.description: Custom-field values for the booking, when present.

401.description: The authenticated user lacks permission to view bookings.

500.description: Returned as plain text `error happened` when the record cannot be fetched — including when the id does not exist (a not-found case is not surfaced as 404).
